title: 移动选择与生命刻度

source.prompt: TrackType: SFX. TrackType: Sound Effect, VocalType: Instrumental. Original isolated retro fantasy tactical game sound effect, crisp and restrained, mobile-speaker-friendly midrange, no copied recording. No music, no melody, no speech, no singing, no choir, no background ambience. One very short soft dry electronic tick, rounded attack, muted woody-pulse timbre, clear but unobtrusive. Designed for rapidly repeated menu selection and numeric meter updates. No sequence, no melody, no ringing. Rounded muted electronic pulse with a softly sustained sixty millisecond body, not a needle click or a mechanical mouse click. Single isolated one-shot, immediate attack and natural decay within 0.12 seconds. Then silence. No second event, no repeated sequence, no music or voice.
source.negative_prompt: music, melody, rhythm loop, vocals, speech, singing, choir, crowd, harsh distortion, clipping, long reverb, background noise, cinematic trailer

editing.method: first meaningful onset, first transient, natural-decay search, bounded envelope tail

mastering.method: constant active-RMS gain with category peak ceiling
mastering.active_rms_comparison_method: 220-sample (approximately 5ms) stereo RMS windows; active=max(0.03*max_window_rms,-55dBFS), matching source baseline
mastering.basis: Preserve original relative levels: UI not louder in active RMS; ordinary impacts at most +2dB and magic +1dB; sustained textures capped at -23dBFS active RMS.

metrics.lufs_note: Integrated loudness is not meaningful for events shorter than 400ms; use active RMS and true peak.

auditory_review_note: Objective signal/timing checks only; sound identity, absence of speech/music and subjective fatigue need listening.
